name: Create an artifact deployment record
description: Create an artifact deployment record Create or update deployment records for an artifact associated with an organization. POST /orgs/{org}/artifacts/metadata/deployment-record
context:
POST /orgs/{org}/artifacts/metadata/deployment-record
Create or update deployment records for an artifact associated with an organization. This endpoint allows you to record information about a specific artifact, such as its name, digest, environments, cluster, and deployment. The deployment name has to be uniqe within a cluster (i.e a combination of logical, physical environment and cluster) as it identifies unique deployment. Multiple requests for the same combination of logical, physical environment, cluster and deployment name will only create one record, successive request will update the existing record. This allows for a stable tracking of a deployment where the actual deployed artifact can change over time.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)

name: Create artifact metadata storage record
description: Create artifact metadata storage record Create metadata storage records for artifacts associated with an organization. POST /orgs/{org}/artifacts/metadata/storage-record
context:
POST /orgs/{org}/artifacts/metadata/storage-record
Create metadata storage records for artifacts associated with an organization. This endpoint will create a new artifact storage record on behalf of any artifact matching the provided digest and associated with a repository owned by the organization.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)

name: Create a cluster deployment records job
description: Create a cluster deployment records job Create a background job to set deployment records for a given cluster. POST /orgs/{org}/artifacts/metadata/deployment-record/cluster/{cluster}/jobs
context:
POST /orgs/{org}/artifacts/metadata/deployment-record/cluster/{cluster}/jobs
Create a background job to set deployment records for a given cluster. Performs validation and permission checks synchronously, returning rejected deployments immediately, then enqueues a background job for the actual deployment updates. Use the companion GET endpoint to poll for job status.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; cluster (path) — The cluster name.; body (body)

name: Get cluster deployment records job status
description: Get cluster deployment records job status Get the status and results of a previously created cluster deployment records job. GET /orgs/{org}/artifacts/metadata/deployment-record/cluster/{cluster}/jobs/{job_id}

name: List artifact deployment records
description: List artifact deployment records List deployment records for an artifact metadata associated with an organization. GET /orgs/{org}/artifacts/{subject_digest}/metadata/deployment-records
context:
GET /orgs/{org}/artifacts/{subject_digest}/metadata/deployment-records
List deployment records for an artifact metadata associated with an organization.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; subject_digest (path) — The SHA256 digest of the artifact, in the form `sha256:HEX_DIGEST`.

name: List artifact storage records
description: List artifact storage records List artifact storage records with a given subject digest for repositories owned by an organization. GET /orgs/{org}/artifacts/{subject_digest}/metadata/storage-records
context:
GET /orgs/{org}/artifacts/{subject_digest}/metadata/storage-records
List artifact storage records with a given subject digest for repositories owned by an organization. Results are filtered by the authenticated user's permissions; records for repositories the user cannot read are omitted. Fine-grained access tokens require the `artifact-metadata:read` permission.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; subject_digest (path) — The parameter should be set to the attestation's subject's SHA256 digest, in the form `sha256:HEX_DIGEST`.

name: Set cluster deployment records
description: Set cluster deployment records Set deployment records for a given cluster. POST /orgs/{org}/artifacts/metadata/deployment-record/cluster/{cluster}
